hero.title: Secure Document Sharing & Client Approval Portals
hero.subtitle: Stop chasing approvals over email and WhatsApp. We build branded portals where clients open documents securely, approve or comment in a few taps, and every sign-off is logged with a full audit trail you own outright.

deliver.name: Branded Client Portal
deliver.description: A login-protected portal under your own domain where each client signs in to see only their own documents, pending approvals, and full history, on any device.

deliver.name: Secure Document Vault
deliver.description: Encrypted storage with expiring share links, download limits, and optional watermarking so sensitive contracts and records never leak outside the people meant to see them.

deliver.name: Approval & Sign-Off Flows
deliver.description: Configurable, multi-step approval routes where clients accept, reject with a reason, or request changes, with comments tied to the exact document and version under review.

deliver.name: Audit Trail & Records
deliver.description: Every view, download, and decision is timestamped and attributed to a named user, giving you a tamper-evident, exportable record of exactly who approved what and when.

deliver.name: Version Control & History
deliver.description: Replace an outdated file without losing the trail, so clients always open the current version while you keep every prior revision and the notes behind each change.

deliver.name: Notifications & Reminders
deliver.description: Automated WhatsApp and email alerts nudge clients toward pending approvals and confirm completed sign-offs, so nothing stalls in an inbox or an unread chat.

outcomes.label: Faster Approvals
outcomes.description: Clients review and approve from their phone in minutes instead of waiting days for an email reply or a printed, scanned signature to come back.

outcomes.label: Defensible Records
outcomes.description: A complete, timestamped audit trail of every view and sign-off protects you in disputes and satisfies internal governance and compliance checks.

outcomes.label: Fewer Lost Files
outcomes.description: One secure source of truth replaces scattered email attachments and WhatsApp forwards, so the right document is always at hand and nothing goes missing.

outcomes.label: Professional Trust
outcomes.description: A branded, secure portal shows clients that your firm handles their documents and approvals seriously and consistently, every single time.

faqs.question: How is this different from sharing files over WhatsApp or email?
faqs.answer: Email and WhatsApp scatter documents across threads with no record of who saw or approved what. The portal gives each client one secure place to review and sign off, and logs every action with a timestamp and a named user. You get clear proof of approval instead of hunting through chat history.

faqs.question: Can clients approve documents in Arabic?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every portal is delivered fully bilingual in Arabic and English with correct right-to-left layout, so clients read and approve in the language they prefer. The audit trail and the WhatsApp and email notifications follow the same language settings.

faqs.question: Is it secure enough for sensitive contracts and records?
faqs.answer: Files are encrypted at rest, share links can be set to expire, and downloads can be limited or watermarked. Role-based access means each person sees only what they are permitted to. We can also host within the GCC and align the setup with your internal data policies.

faqs.question: Do we own the portal, or are we locked into a subscription?
faqs.answer: You fully own the source code, the data, and the documentation. There is no per-seat license and no vendor lock-in, and you can host it wherever you choose. We hand over everything so your team stays in control of the portal and every document inside it.

faqs.question: Can it connect to e-signatures and our existing systems?
faqs.answer: Yes. We can wire in e-signature flows and connect the portal to your CRM, ERP, or document storage so approved files move straight into your workflow. We start with a free consultation and a demo preview so you can see it working before any commitment.
